flow: User picks technical or preference, then taps items. UI sends them as fix_requests [{code, instruction, note?}].

items.label: A person or figure appears
items.instruction: The location must be completely empty of people, figures, silhouettes and reflections of people. Remove every living figure.

items.label: Text or signs look garbled
items.instruction: Remove all readable text, signs and writing; replace with symbols, colors or blank surfaces.

items.label: Perspective or architecture looks warped
items.instruction: Make the architecture structurally plausible: consistent perspective, straight verticals unless the style demands otherwise, coherent proportions, no melting or impossible geometry.

items.label: Too dark, details are lost
items.instruction: Lift shadow areas so architecture, materials and fixed anchors stay clearly visible, keeping the same time of day and mood.

items.label: It came out as a collage or split image
items.instruction: Render ONE continuous frame: no panels, grid, borders or split screen.

items.label: Objects are duplicated or melted
items.instruction: Make every object distinct, single and fully formed; remove duplicated, fused or distorted objects.

items.label: Doors or windows are not where the layout says
items.instruction: Place every opening and fixed object exactly where the layout and the prompt state; do not add, move or remove any.

items.label: The style is not respected
items.instruction: Render the whole frame in the effective style only: form language, materials, surface rendering, light and line work must match it, with no mixing of other styles.

items.label: A character or prop that belongs elsewhere appears
items.instruction: Remove all characters and every asset listed in exclude_assets from the scene; they must not appear.

items.label: Too clean or too empty
items.instruction: Add believable lived-in set dressing and surface wear, keeping architecture and layout unchanged.

items.label: Too messy or too busy
items.instruction: Reduce clutter and simplify set dressing, keeping architecture, layout and mood unchanged.

items.label: Wrong time of day or light
items.instruction: Change the lighting and time of day as stated in the note, keeping architecture and layout unchanged.

items.label: Wrong colors or materials
items.instruction: Change the palette or materials as stated in the note, keeping geometry unchanged.

items.label: Feels too small or too big
items.instruction: Change the perceived scale as stated in the note, using architecture and scale cues rather than people.

items.label: Doesn't feel like the genre or style
items.instruction: Strengthen the genre lens and style lens in layout, dressing, light and rendering, keeping the fixed anchors.

items.label: I don't like the layout itself
items.instruction: Redesign the layout as described in the note. Update DNA, layout and coverage consistently, then regenerate the Hero.

items.label: The mood is off
items.instruction: Shift the atmosphere to the mood stated in the note using light, color, weather and dressing, not new structures.

items.label: Change the style (Pro only)
items.instruction: Re-render in the style sent as style_override. Keep architecture, layout and fixed anchors identical.
